pr_summary: Fix token Type defaulting in gRPC transport. When a Token's Type field is empty, the authorization header should default to 'Bearer' instead of producing a malformed header. The fix adds a setAuthMetadata helper that checks if Type is empty and substitutes 'Bearer' before constructing the authorization metadata.
environment_management: Standard Go modules with go.mod/go.sum files. The repo uses a go.work workspace file for multi-module development.
patch_file_cues: auth/grpctransport/grpctransport.go - modified GetRequestMetadata to use new setAuthMetadata helper
auth/grpctransport/grpctransport.go - added setAuthMetadata function that defaults empty Type to 'Bearer'
auth/grpctransport/dial_socketopt_test.go - test fix for staticTP struct change
test_file_cues: auth/grpctransport/grpctransport_test.go - new test TestGrpcCredentialsProvider_TokenType verifies both 'Basic' and default 'Bearer' token types
auth/grpctransport/grpctransport_test.go - staticTP struct changed from string to struct with tok field

notes: This is the Google Cloud Client Libraries for Go repository. The fix is in the auth/grpctransport package which handles gRPC transport and authentication. The issue is that when Token.Type is empty, the authorization header was malformed. The fix adds a setAuthMetadata helper that checks if Type is empty and defaults to 'Bearer' using internal.TokenTypeBearer constant. The test file was updated to include a new test case TestGrpcCredentialsProvider_TokenType that verifies both explicit type ('Basic') and default type ('Bearer') behavior. The repository uses Go modules with go 1.19 minimum version.
